reading_note: The teaching traces the genesis of falsity from evil as a self-generated counter-creation. It begins by establishing that the two eternal principles (good and its opposite, self-love) are beyond man's natural power to know. Then it narrates the moment self-love rose up against the Light, the consequent commingling of life with death, and—centrally—how the inner deliberation of self-love (its enthymesis = the Hyle of Death) begot from herself alone, without conjunction with truth, a sterile counter-progeny: the elements of falsity (smoke/fire/wind/water/darkness), then trees of false perception, then fruits as garments of evil works. From this self-begotten matrix the archon plots war against the Kingdom of Light, and the First Man (divine truth in human form) is sent forth clothed in the five elements of light to engage the conflict. The single arc: how falsity-from-evil generates an entire false cosmos by self-reflection, and how the Lord answers by sending divine truth clothed for combat.
